subject: ela
intro: Eighth graders determine a central idea of a text and analyze its development over the course of the text, including its relationship to supporting ideas; they provide an objective summary. The central idea is built up by supporting ideas and details throughout the text.

items.prompt:
Read.

Exercise improves health. It strengthens the heart, builds muscle, and, studies show, boosts mood and focus.

What is the central idea, and how do the details support it?

steps: The central idea is the main point; the details back it up.
Central idea: exercise improves health. Details: heart, muscle, mood, focus.
So the central idea is that exercise improves health, supported by specific physical and mental benefits.
solution.answer: Central idea: exercise improves health; details list physical and mental benefits.

steps: State the key points, no opinion.
So: 'Exercise improves health by strengthening the body and boosting mood and focus.'
solution.answer: 'Exercise improves health by strengthening the body and boosting mood and focus.'

items.prompt: A central idea is built up by ____ ideas and details.
The main point of an informational text is the ____ idea.
An opinion-free retelling is an ____ summary.
Details that back the main point are ____ ideas.
